scope: demo component shard only; lesson, course, and registry untouched
d1_objective: The learner sees a fixed-amplitude tone rotate through phase, watches its in-phase and quadrature projections trade value, finds the phase where a sine-only amplitude estimate vanishes, and then sees the I/Q magnitude and wrapped phase remain correct across the entire phase family.

implementation.client_boundary: use client is the first line; default export; no props
implementation.controls: Two labelled PresetGroups, one kit Button, and one kit Slider; all controls are native keyboard-operable elements with at least 44px kit touch targets.
implementation.readouts: TargetList and Readout expose live I, Q, active amplitude/error, phase availability, wrapped phase/circular error, FALSIFIED/PASS state, and dense-sweep maxima.
implementation.visual: Two responsive fluid SVGs show the I/Q phasor and both detector bars; a third shows 20 separate integer sample stems with no interpolating line.

math_contract.record: x[n]=cos(0.3 pi n + phi), n=0..19; exactly three cycles
math_contract.projections: I=(2/N) sum x cos; Q=-(2/N) sum x sin; P=I+jQ
math_contract.canonical_phase: (-180,180], with -180 displayed as +180 and circular phase error
math_contract.sine_only: Ahat=abs(Q); phase unavailable; FALSIFIED only when abs(Q)<1e-12 and relative amplitude error>0.99
math_contract.iq: Ahat=hypot(I,Q); phase=atan2(Q,I); PASS gates use strict amplitude error<0.01 and circular phase error<2 degrees
math_contract.phase_zero_rule: The benchmark fixes nonzero A=1. The live readout states that phase would be undefined at zero recovered magnitude.

initial_markup.command: npx tsx inline ReactDOMServer assertion harness
initial_markup.checks: The initial markup contains both named task presets, Not yet, I=0.798636, Q=0.601815, and no NaN or Infinity.

deterministic_cases: 37-degree I, Q, sine-only error, I/Q amplitude, phase, and zero circular error
90-degree sine peak with near-zero I and unit Q
0-degree sine null with 100 percent sine-only error and valid I/Q recovery
+180 and -180 endpoints both displayed as canonical +180 with zero circular error
strict-boundary rejection at exactly 1 percent and exactly 2 degrees
zero-magnitude phase is null in the generalized assertion harness
orthogonal-record sums cos squared=10, sin squared=10, and cross sum approximately zero

self_review.D1: PASS: phase manipulation reveals the one-projection null and the invariant paired radius/angle.
self_review.D2: PASS: all 20-sample projections and SVG updates are synchronous; the 1,441-point sweep is computed once at module initialization.
self_review.D3: PASS: 37 degrees is nondegenerate and informative; four named phase presets match the lesson task.
self_review.D4: PASS: the live target list recognizes the exact FALSIFIED null and the separate strict all-phase I/Q PASS.
self_review.D5: PASS: one 143-line default-exported client file, existing UI imports only, no network, context, CSS file, or dependency.
self_review.accessible: PASS by implementation review: labelled native kit controls, explicit aria-valuetext, polite live regions, dynamic SVG labels, direct color-role labels, different solid/dashed projections, active outlines, and numeric verdicts.
self_review.mobile_theme: PASS by implementation review: default one-column layout, sm two-column upper visuals, wrapping preset rows, fluid 280/360-unit viewBoxes, currentColor/theme tokens, and no fixed-width container.
self_review.registry_validation: DEFERRED by explicit scope: the closing owner must add the explicit lazy registry entry before browser interaction inspection.

manual_after_registry_lands: Inspect desktop and 360px layouts in light and dark themes.
Keyboard-select both detector modes and all four phase cases, then arrow the slider through -180, 0, and +180.
Press New seeded phase six times and confirm -176, 58, -66, 176, 47, and 103 degrees.
Confirm the sine-null target says FALSIFIED and switching to I/Q leaves samples/I/Q unchanged while producing PASS.
